implementation.basis: Independent event controller and React composition for the public root/UI/sidecar contracts on React19 and modern DOM. No upstream runtime copied.

changes: One native listener set per owner document, with a stack of active locks.
Captured event identity in WeakSets replaces timer-expired event matching queues.
Compose forwarded child refs and capture handlers.
Use VPM scrollbar, stylesheet, callback-ref and sidecar implementations; remove tslib.
Track touch movement incrementally and support composed shadow paths; clip overflow is not scrollable.
